operations.name: M. Staurt

expected.charges: Federal prosecution under the Espionage Act of 1917 and/or the Sedition Act of 1918.

updates.sentence: Six-year prison sentence, commuted to eighteen months. Kohn records Leavenworth imprisonment beginning April 17, 1920. The commuted term is a sentence, not a verified actual-time-served total; the release date remains unresolved.

operations.source: Stephen M. Kohn, American Political Prisoners (1994), p.133, entry M. Staurt, note401. https://dokumen.pub/american-political-prisoners-prosecutions-under-the-espionage-and-sedition-acts-0275944158-9780275944155.html
